postAuthSessionExchanges.description: Atomically exchange a browser-purpose code for an independent browser session. The source session must still be active; expired or replayed codes are rejected.

postAuthLoginLinks.description: Create a HTTPS browser login link with a 60-second single-use code bound to the active source session. Long-lived credentials never appear in the URL.

postMeLoginLinks.description: Create a HTTPS browser login link with a 60-second single-use code bound to the active source session. Logout, source expiry or account suspension invalidates unredeemed codes.

getMeClientConfig.description: FastAI native YAML uses default.fastai.yaml or custom.fastai.yaml, independently of public subscription templates. Only real proxy nodes are emitted; subscription information nodes and subscription-userinfo headers are omitted. Account information is read through the account/subscription JSON APIs. Geo databases are bundled with FastAI; automatic Geo updates and remote HTTP rule providers are prohibited, including custom templates.

postAuthClientSessionExchanges.description: Atomically exchange an app-purpose code using S256 PKCE and the original redirect URI. Codes expire after 60 seconds and require an active source session; the resulting App session is independently revocable.

getAuthBrowserSession.description: Browser-only scoped HttpOnly session. X-Browser-Client selects user/admin; mutations require an exact allowed Origin and synchronizer X-CSRF-Token. POST migrates a valid legacy token during the configured transition window.

postAuthBrowserSession.description: Browser-only scoped HttpOnly session. X-Browser-Client selects user/admin; mutations require an exact allowed Origin and synchronizer X-CSRF-Token. POST migrates a valid legacy token during the configured transition window.

deleteAuthBrowserSession.description: Browser-only scoped HttpOnly session. X-Browser-Client selects user/admin; mutations require an exact allowed Origin and synchronizer X-CSRF-Token. POST migrates a valid legacy token during the configured transition window.
